articles.title: Saka injury 'does not look good' - how will Arsenal cope?
articles.summary: Mikel Arteta says the quadriceps injury Arsenal's Bukayo Saka picked up in the Champions League draw with Bayern Munich "does not look good at all".

articles.title: McDermott blasts 'harsh' RL World Cup format | 'Lewis has shown humility'
articles.summary: England head coach Brian McDermott has branded the format of the Rugby League World Cup as "harsh" with his side up against it to progress.
